PROP-lean-bound-003.text: Validator-set intersection weight must be bounded below by a churn-adjusted (activation/exit) expression
PROP-lean-bound-003.assertion: validator_intersection_lower_bound guarantees [max (weight stake vL - actwt stake v0 vL - extwt stake v0 vR) (weight stake vR - actwt stake v0 vR - extwt stake v0 vL) ≤ weight stake (vL ∩ vR)] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: max(wt(vL)-actwt(v0,vL)-extwt(v0,vR), wt(vR)-actwt(v0,vR)-extwt(v0,vL)) <= wt(vL inter vR)
